presentation.summary: Downloads theme songs for movies and series, with season openings and endings for anime from AnimeThemes.
presentation.description_markdown:
Downloads theme audio for movies and series from ThemerrDB, and opening and ending themes for anime series from AnimeThemes. Themes are saved as MP3 in each item's `theme-music` folder, leveled to the same volume, and existing themes are never replaced unless you ask for themes that don't match the settings to be downloaded again. Theme Songs runs when Silo starts and after Silo scans new items, and once a day while the plugin stays running.

AnimeThemes was a separate plugin before version 0.2.0. Uninstall it after installing this version; Theme Songs keeps managing the themes it downloaded.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Create an API key in **Administration → API Keys**, paste it into **Silo API key** and save.
2. Open **Theme Songs** in the admin menu. The first run starts shortly after, and the page lets you choose libraries.

Silo writes themes into your media folders, so they must be writable. Silo's Docker Compose file mounts media read-only; remove `:ro` from the media volume and recreate the container. Restart Silo to see **Download Theme Songs** in **Scheduled Tasks**.

The daily run needs the plugin to stay running, and Silo stops the plugin when you save its settings. For a run every day, open **Download Theme Songs** in **Administration → Scheduled Tasks**, choose **Edit Schedule** and **Add Trigger**, set the trigger to **Daily** and save.

On Silo versions without plugin settings checks, **Check Connection** says connection checks are not supported for this plugin. That is not an error.

capabilities.description: Downloads movie and series themes. Theme Songs also runs after library scans; add a daily trigger here for a run every day.

global_config_schema.title: Theme Songs settings
global_config_schema.description: Only the API key is required.

fields.label: Silo API key
fields.description: Create one in Administration → API Keys with an administrator account. Theme Songs uses it to read your libraries and to ask Silo to scan each new theme.

fields.label: Skip these libraries
fields.description: Library IDs separated by commas. Theme Songs uses every other movie and series library, including ones you add later. The Theme Songs page lists your libraries with checkboxes.

fields.label: Only these libraries
fields.description: Library IDs separated by commas. Leave empty to use every movie and series library.

fields.label: Dry run
fields.description: List what would be downloaded on the Theme Songs page without saving any files.

fields.label: Use AnimeThemes for anime
fields.description: Series that AnimeThemes knows get their openings and endings in each season folder. Other series and all movies use ThemerrDB.

fields.label: Allow anime themes marked as spoilers
Allow anime themes marked as NSFW
Suggest YouTube matches
fields.description: When ThemerrDB has no theme for an item, search YouTube and list candidates on the Theme Songs page. Nothing is downloaded until you save a URL for the item.

fields.label: Theme volume
fields.description: Levels every download to the same loudness, so a quiet film score and a loud anime opening play at the same volume. Loudness is measured in LUFS: a step of 1 is about 1 dB, and 10 steps sound about twice as loud. Each theme gets one fixed gain, so its dynamics stay intact; a theme that can't get that loud without clipping stays a little quieter. Changes apply to new downloads, or to every theme with the switch below.

options.label: Very quiet (−23 LUFS): European TV broadcasts
Soft (−18 LUFS): the ReplayGain reference level
Balanced (−16 LUFS, default): Apple Music and most podcasts
Loud (−14 LUFS): Spotify, YouTube and Tidal
Very loud (−11 LUFS): Spotify's Loud setting
Original: each source as released, so volumes vary

fields.label: Re-download themes that don't match these settings
fields.description: Each run replaces themes Theme Songs downloaded when their volume or source no longer matches these settings, and removes anime themes the settings no longer select. A replaced theme stays until its replacement is saved. Themes you added or edited are never touched.

fields.label: AnimeThemes libraries
fields.description: Library IDs separated by commas. Leave empty to check every series library for anime.

fields.label: Skip these items
fields.description: Catalog item IDs separated by commas.

fields.label: Install yt-dlp and Deno
fields.description: The first theme that comes from YouTube installs them in the plugin's state directory, which uses about 190 MB. Turn off to use your own from PATH.

fields.label: Silo URL
fields.description: Needed only when the plugin cannot reach Silo at its internal address.

fields.label: Profile ID
fields.placeholder: The API key owner's primary profile

fields.label: Persistent state directory
fields.description: Needed only when Silo installs plugins outside its plugin directory.

fields.label: Writable roots and path mappings (JSON)
fields.description: Needed only when the plugin sees media at other paths than Silo. The README describes the format.

fields.label: ThemerrDB and YouTube settings (JSON)
fields.description: Per-item URL overrides and the other options in the README.

fields.label: AnimeThemes settings (JSON)
fields.description: Manual mappings, selection overrides and the other options in the README.
